+  defp load_config(path) do
+    case File.read(path) do
+      {:ok, content} ->

+      {:error, :enoent} ->
+        %{}
+
+      {:error, reason} ->
+        IO.puts(:stderr, "warning: cannot read #{path}: #{:file.format_error(reason)}")

+  defp parse_config(content, path) do
+    content
+    |> String.split("\n")
+    |> Enum.with_index(1)
+    |> Enum.reject(fn {line, _} ->
+      t = String.trim(line)
+      t == "" or String.starts_with?(t, "#")
+    end)
+    |> Enum.reduce(%{}, fn {line, lineno}, acc ->
+      case String.split(String.trim(line), ~r/\s+/, parts: 2) do
+        [key, value] ->
+          parse_config_entry(acc, key, String.trim(value), path, lineno)
+
+        _ ->
+          IO.puts(:stderr, "warning: #{path}:#{lineno}: malformed line, ignoring")
+          acc
+      end
+    end)
+  end

+  defp parse_config_entry(acc, key, value, path, lineno) do
+    warn = fn msg -> IO.puts(:stderr, "warning: #{path}:#{lineno}: #{msg}, ignoring") end
+
+    case key do

+        end
+
+      _ ->

+    end
+  end
